t: Above you is Maman, a giant spider by the French-American artist Louise Bourgeois. Made in 1999 of bronze, stainless steel and marble, it is among the largest sculptures of its kind in the world, over thirty feet high and thirty-three feet wide. Look for the sac under its body, which holds thirty-two marble eggs. Bourgeois spent a long career exploring family, the body and memory, drawing on events from her own childhood. This is one of several casts in different places.
